solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: He's after a feline clutching a strip of leather — disaster!

indicators.note: after tells us the pronoun comes at the end, behind the other pieces

parts.note: a feline is a cat
taken as written
a strop is a leather strip for sharpening razors
taken as written, the 's being 'is'

explanation.surface: A man trails a cat holding a razor strop, and calamity follows.
explanation.walkthrough: 'clutching' only links the cat to what follows; the pieces simply sit side by side.
explanation.definitionFit: A catastrophe is a sudden calamity, a close synonym of disaster.

clue.text: A mother for the first orphan?

parts.note: a dam is the mother of an animal, especially livestock

explanation.surface: A mother is sought for a child who has lost his parents.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is playful: the first man in Genesis was created, so he had no mother or father, making him in a sense the first orphan.
explanation.definitionFit: In the Bible the first man was made from dust and had no parents, hence a whimsical first orphan.

clue.text: Birds seen when another ascends

indicators.note: in a down clue, ascending means the word is read from the bottom up

parts.note: another bird, namely the skua, a predatory seabird

explanation.surface: Some birds appear only when a different one rises into the air.
explanation.walkthrough: 'another' stands for a second bird, the skua, which read upwards gives the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Auks are diving seabirds such as puffins and guillemots.

clue.text: An outside line to ring

parts.note: sounds like a telephone line for external calls, but describes a straight line touching a circle from outside

explanation.surface: Someone asks for an external telephone line to make a call.
explanation.definitionFit: In geometry this is a straight line meeting a circle at one point without crossing it.

clue.text: Resistance units initially on the monarch's behalf

definitions.meaning: the initials of On Her Majesty's Service, printed on official British mail

explanation.surface: Electrical units are said to act, at first, in the sovereign's name.
explanation.walkthrough: Official British government envelopes were marked with these initials, standing for On Her Majesty's Service.
explanation.definitionFit: The ohm is the SI unit of electrical resistance, so ohms are resistance units.

clue.text: Getting a small rise, I'll get in some wine

indicators.note: get in says one piece is placed inside the other

parts.note: hock is a German white wine from the Rhine
taken as written, the apostrophe dropped

explanation.surface: A drinker cheers up by buying some wine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a small rise' reads as a lift in spirits, but it is a little hill. HOCK is a British name for Rhine wine.
explanation.definitionFit: A hillock is a small hill or mound, literally a small rise in the ground.

clue.text: They have lots to offer

parts.note: sounds like generous people, but lots are items put up for sale in a saleroom

explanation.surface: Some people have plenty to give.
explanation.definitionFit: These salesroom officials offer numbered lots to bidders.

clue.text: Struck by the way a sale may be concluded

definitions.meaning: hit to the ground, as by a car

definitions.text: the way a sale may be concluded
definitions.meaning: at auction a lot is sold when the hammer falls

explanation.definitionFit: Being hit and felled is one sense; an auctioneer's hammer completing a sale is the other.

clue.text: Change the course of a revolution

explanation.surface: Someone sets out to redirect a political uprising.
explanation.definitionFit: To turn is to alter direction; a turn is also one rotation of a wheel.

clue.text: Wolves, say, or beasts of burden

definitions.meaning: wolves are animals that live and hunt in packs
animals used to carry loads, such as mules

explanation.definitionFit: Animals hunting in groups and animals carrying loads are both described by this phrase.

clue.text: Ring starts twitching of the ear

indicators.note: starts says the ring shape comes first in the answer

parts.note: a ring is round, like the letter O
a tic is an involuntary twitching

explanation.surface: A ringing sound sets off a twitch in someone's ear.
explanation.definitionFit: Otic is a medical adjective meaning relating to the ear.

clue.text: Top dog of the Variety Club?

definitions.text: Top dog of the Variety Club?

parts.words: Top dog of the Variety Club?
parts.note: the leader of the Variety Club charity is given a circus-style title, and a dog is a barker

explanation.surface: Who is the leading hound at a showbusiness club?
explanation.walkthrough: The Variety Club is a showbusiness charity whose members are 'barkers' (like fairground callers), and its head has this title.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the official title of the head of the Variety Club charity, a pun on a dog's bark.

clue.text: Call round to set up joint management

indicators.note: set up means the letters are rearranged into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Telephone people to arrange shared leadership.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to' belongs to the fodder; 'set up' rearranges CALL ROUND TO.
explanation.definitionFit: Dual control is a system of joint command, as in a learner car with two sets of pedals.

clue.text: He was bound to begin, but not finish, his performance

definitions.text: He was bound to begin, but not finish, his performance

parts.words: He was bound to begin, but not finish, his performance
parts.note: describes an escapologist, tied up at the start of an act but free at its end

explanation.surface: A performer was sure to start his act but never complete it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bound to' seems to mean 'certain to', but it means literally tied up: the famous escape artist began each act in chains.
explanation.definitionFit: Harry Houdini was a celebrated escapologist who began his acts bound and ended them free.

clue.text: Captain Kidd, perhaps, lost his head in a rage

indicators.note: losing the head means the first letter of the word is dropped

parts.note: William Kidd was a notorious seagoing raider

explanation.surface: A famous buccaneer was beheaded while furious.
explanation.walkthrough: Captain Kidd was hanged, not beheaded, but the surface plays on execution.
explanation.definitionFit: Irate is an adjective meaning very angry, the same as being in a rage.

clue.text: His Christmas present was one of three

definitions.text: His Christmas present was one of three

parts.words: His Christmas present was one of three
parts.note: a gift seems meant, but the Ghost of Christmas Present was one of three spirits visiting a miser

explanation.surface: A man received one of three Christmas gifts.
explanation.walkthrough: In Dickens's A Christmas Carol the miser is visited by the ghosts of Christmas Past, Present and Yet to Come.
explanation.definitionFit: Ebenezer Scrooge is the miser in A Christmas Carol visited by three spirits.

clue.text: Householder in no hurry to move

definitions.text: Householder in no hurry to move

parts.words: Householder in no hurry to move
parts.note: sounds like a settled homeowner, but describes a slow creature carrying its shell home

explanation.surface: A homeowner is content to stay put.
explanation.definitionFit: This slow-moving mollusc carries its shell, its house, on its back.

clue.text: Jumbo jet propeller?

parts.note: sounds like an aircraft part, but Jumbo is an elephant and it squirts a jet of water

explanation.surface: Which part drives a large passenger airliner?
explanation.definitionFit: An elephant's long nose squirts jets of water.

clue.text: They may be found in a creel, squirming

indicators.note: may be found in says the letters lie concealed within the words that follow

explanation.surface: Some creatures can be discovered wriggling in a fishing basket.
explanation.walkthrough: 'squirming' looks like an anagram signal, but the letters run on from the end of 'creel' into its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: These wriggling fish would naturally be the creatures in a creel.

clue.text: A reversible action

indicators.note: reversible says the word reads the same backwards as forwards

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: Some action can be undone.
explanation.definitionFit: A deed is an act or action that someone performs.

clue.text: One involved in unusual cost was philosophical

indicators.note: involved in places one piece inside another
unusual means the letters are rearranged

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: Someone facing an odd expense took it calmly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unusual' rearranges COST to STOC, and 'involved in' puts I inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: To be stoic or philosophical is to accept hardship calmly without complaint.

clue.text: Possibly ignores an Italian man's entitlement

indicators.note: possibly signals that the letters may be arranged differently

explanation.surface: An Italian man perhaps disregards what he is due.
explanation.walkthrough: 'entitlement' means the title given to a man.
explanation.definitionFit: Signore is the Italian form of address for a man, equivalent to Mr or sir.

clue.text: La Costa resort by the sea

indicators.note: resort is read as re-sort, so the letters are sorted again into new order

explanation.surface: A Spanish holiday resort lies on the sea.
explanation.walkthrough: 'resort' looks like a noun for a holiday town, but it means 'sort again'.
explanation.definitionFit: Coastal means situated on or near the coast, beside the sea.

clue.text: Camera for young girl who promises to do her best

definitions.meaning: a cheap box camera made by Kodak

definitions.text: young girl who promises to do her best
definitions.meaning: a junior Girl Guide, whose promise is to do her best

explanation.surface: A camera is bought for a girl in the Guides.
explanation.walkthrough: The Kodak box camera of this name was popular; the Girl Guides' junior section uses the same name.
explanation.definitionFit: This is both a classic Kodak box camera and a member of the junior Girl Guides.

clue.text: Wild blow leads to dispute with non-intellectual

indicators.note: wild means the letters are scrambled into a different order

parts.note: a row is a noisy quarrel or dispute, and 'leads to' places it after the scrambled letters

explanation.surface: An uncontrolled punch sparks a quarrel with a boorish person.
explanation.definitionFit: Lowbrow describes someone or something uncultured, with no intellectual pretensions.

clue.text: Famous actor making a comeback? Nonsense!

indicators.note: making a comeback says the word comes back, read in reverse

parts.note: a famous actor is a star

explanation.surface: A well-known performer returns to the screen, to scorn.
explanation.definitionFit: Rats! is an exclamation of irritation or dismissal, like Nonsense!

clue.text: Keys admit private secretary to part of church

indicators.note: admit means the outer letters let the other piece in

parts.note: A and E are musical keys
PS stands for private secretary

explanation.surface: Keys let an aide into a section of the church.
explanation.definitionFit: An apse is a semicircular recess, typically at the east end of a church.

clue.text: Guns are raised in this game

indicators.note: in a down clue, raised means read from the bottom up

parts.note: gat is slang for a gun

explanation.surface: Shotguns are lifted while hunting this quarry.
explanation.definitionFit: A stag is a male deer, hunted as game.

clue.text: An outstanding leader of men

definitions.meaning: a raised stud or knob that stands out from a surface

explanation.surface: A remarkable man leads his people.
explanation.definitionFit: A boss is a projecting knob, literally outstanding, and also a person in charge.

clue.text: Challenge the basis of capitalism

definitions.meaning: rivalry between businesses underlies free markets

explanation.surface: A test is set to the foundation of free enterprise.
explanation.definitionFit: A contest is one sense; market rivalry, the engine of capitalism, is the other.

clue.text: His victims lose heart

parts.note: sounds like people becoming discouraged, but those struck by the love god's arrows give their hearts away

explanation.surface: Those he attacks become dispirited.
explanation.definitionFit: Eros is the Greek god of love, whose arrows make people fall in love.

clue.text: Lineages got from him? Yes

indicators.note: from says the answer is produced out of the letters before it, rearranged

explanation.surface: Asked whether family trees come from a certain researcher, the reply is yes.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is both definition and wordplay: a rearrangement of LINEAGES GOT gives the person who traces lineages.
explanation.definitionFit: A genealogist researches family descent and produces lineages.
